text:
debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r c-o-o-r-d-i-n-a-t-e-d b-i-d-d-i-n-g a-g-r-e-e-m-e-n-t-s w-i-t-h c-o-m-p-e-t-i-t-o-r-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a l-o-g of c-o-v-e-r b-i-d s-u-b-m-i-s-s-i-o-n-s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-e-n-d-e-r a-n-t-i-c-o-m-p-e-t-i-t-i-o-n d-i-s-c-l-o-s-u-r-e c-h-e-c-k-s.
2) the a-c-t-o-r a-r-r-a-n-g-e-d h-i-d-d-e-n c-o-m-p-e-n-s-a-t-i-o-n p-a-y-m-e-n-t-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a t-r-a-i-l of o-f-f-b-o-o-k t-r-a-n-s-f-e-r r-e-c-o-r-d-s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g f-i-n-a-n-c-i-a-l d-i-s-c-l-o-s-u-r-e v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n p-r-o-c-e-d-u-r-e-s.
3) the a-c-t-o-r e-x-c-h-a-n-g-e-d p-r-i-c-i-n-g i-n-f-o-r-m-a-t-i-o-n a-m-o-n-g b-i-d-d-e-r-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a c-o-p-y of s-h-a-r-e-d q-u-o-t-e s-h-e-e-t-s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g i-n-f-o-r-m-a-t-i-o-n-b-a-r-r-i-e-n-i-n-g a-u-d-i-t t-h-r-e-s-h-o-l-d r-e-v-i-e-w.
4) the a-c-t-o-r e-s-t-a-b-l-i-s-h-e-d a r-o-t-a-t-i-o-n s-c-h-e-d-u-l-e f-o-r w-i-n n-i-n-g b-i-d-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t of a-w-a-r-d r-o-t-a-t-i-o-n r-u-l-e-s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g c-o-n-f-l-i-c-t-o-f-i-n-t-e-r-e-s-t d-e-c-l-a-r-a-t-i-o-n v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
5) the a-c-t-o-r d-e-s-i-g-n-e-d t-h-e p-r-o-c-e-s-s t-o a-p-p-e-a-r c-o-m-p-e-t-i-t-i-v-e, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a r-e-c-o-r-d of f-a-l-s-e c-o-m-p-e-t-i-t-i-o-n m-e-t-r-i-c-s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g p-r-o-c-u-r-e-m-e-n-t i-n-t-e-g-r-i-t-y c-o-m-p-l-i-a-n-c-e c-e-r-t-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
